column2: Fresh clean Default 7 config; no custom keymap, mouse map, or third-party extensions; audio device closed; transport stopped
Track A items A1/A2 and Track B items B1/B2; initial selection A1
Open Action List, move its 701x475 window to x0,y300, select an action result, move the real pointer to B1 at 500,225, then press Enter. The Arrangement remains visible above the Action List.

Action List keyboard Run uses the still-visible Arrangement mouse target: 40529 adds B1 to A1, then 40530 removes B1 and restores A1. GetItemFromPoint reports B1 for both runs; the last-touched track is B.
